title: North Mountain Supply 1 Gallon Glass Jar Wide Mouth with Black Plastic Lid - USDA, BPA-Free, Made in the USA - for Fermenting, Storing, Canning, and Much More!
description:
About this item
1 Gallon Glass Jar with Black Plastic Lid - Perfect for an assortment of purposes.
Great for bulk canning, fermenting, dry storage, cookies, candy and terrariums - Often used for pickles, pickled eggs, kombucha, and various bulk storage items
Glass to avoid absorption of flavors and leaching of chemicals - USDA certified food grade
Made in the USA!
To promote a positive and satisfying customer experience, this product is covered by North Mountain Supply's 30 day hassle-free replacement program, in the event the product is damaged or defective.

reviews_5s: Perfect for what I bought it for.Great jars for making sun tea, collecting change, planting terrariums, storage, etc.. I'm making terrariums and the size is perfect for that. Customer service at North Mountain was great. I ordered two jars and one was broken when it arrived but I went to their website immediately to order a replacement. I followed the procedure and they quickly replied and sent out the replacement. I do question the packing of the original two jars. They were in thin cardboard with no packing material at all and then the boxes were placed in a thin paper bag. The boxes were marked fragile but they were inside a bag which was not marked fragile.Been using this to make kombucha. It works great. No issues thus far with breaking or cracking. Cleaned in the dishwasher just fine. Haven't used the lid. Great 1 gallon jar for the price.Exactly what I needed, great quality for a good price !Perfect for kombucha and sauerkraut!Perfect for our needs. We use these jars for our sun tea. Nice heavy glass, not the thin, more fragile types. Also works great for pickling eggs or cucumbers with the plastic lid, it doesn’t react to the vinegar. Ordered on March 6, received March 9.This jar is exactly what I needed for brewing kombucha! The wide mouth makes it easy to clean and add ingredients, and the glass works well for fermentation. The black plastic lid fits securely, though I use a breathable cover for brewing. For the price, it’s a fantastic deal—simple, well-made, and versatile. Whether you’re fermenting, storing, or canning, this jar is a great choice!These are great for my Kombucha and water Kefir F1's. Definitely buying moreI use this for my sourdough starter. Glass is good quality, lid fits well and seals.Essential for kefir fans. Much easier to clean and control than the small jars.
reviews_1s: I bought this jar to make a fermented pineapple drink, tepache. The second time ever using this vessel, it suddenly sprung a leak and there was a hole near the bottom of the jar. I am sad that I couldn’t start my ferment, and that I now have to spend more money on a higher quality jar. Wouldn’t recommend this product.The quality was fine but only had it for a few days due to it being very fragile. It fell over on a towel and broke. Very upset about it.Be aware that the lid is not on tight when it arrives and so when you lift it out of the box, it will fall and break into a million pieces.Slowly leaksOriginal order arrived with chipped rim. Replacement arrived with cracked plastic lid. Would this have been great for my kitchen? We'll never know.The lid leaks terribly, can’t use it! Don’t recommend at all for liquids.The description says wide mouth jar. It is not. It is an EXTRA wide mouth jar. They look like great jars, but they will not work with my vacuum sealer. Returned them.
